questions.prompt: Mode is TRUE in Auto and FALSE in Manual. Which contact passes power to Red **only in Manual**?
options: -| |-  Mode (normally open)
-|/|-  Mode (normally closed)
-|P|-  Mode (rising edge)
-|N|-  Mode (falling edge)
questions.explanation: A normally closed contact passes power while its tag is FALSE, which is Manual. An edge contact passes power for one scan only.

questions.prompt: Amber is lit by two contacts in series: PB1 then PB2. Fill in when Amber is on.
questions.explanation: Contacts in series make AND: power passes only through both.

questions.prompt: This motor station runs the working program, but something is wrong with its **wiring**. Try the buttons and watch the rungs. Which fault does it have?
options: The wire to Stop is broken: Stop always reads FALSE
The wire to Start is broken: Start always reads FALSE
Start is shorted: it always reads TRUE
There is no seal-in in the program
questions.explanation: Start passes power when pressed, but the Stop contact never does: its input is FALSE all the time, as if Stop were held down. The motor cannot start, which is the safe way to fail.

questions.prompt: This garage door runs the working program, but one input is faulty. Try Open, Close and Stop. Which fault does it have?
options: The top limit switch is shorted: the PLC always thinks the door is at the top
The bottom limit switch is broken
The safety eye is blocked
The Close button is shorted: it always reads pressed
questions.explanation: Open does nothing: on the rungs, OpenLimit reads TRUE although the door is at the bottom, so the Up rung never gets power.

questions.prompt: Match each instruction to what it does.

pairs.right: Turns its tag on, and leaves it on
Passes power for one scan when its tag turns on
Passes power for one scan when its tag turns off

questions.explanation: Set and reset coils latch and unlatch a tag; edge contacts act once, at the moment a tag changes.

questions.prompt: Halfway up the tank, why can the valves not simply follow the floats?
options: The floats read the same while filling and while draining, so the program must remember which it is doing
The floats are too slow for the PLC
A valve cannot be driven by a contact
The PLC scans too fast
questions.explanation: Between the floats the inputs are the same either way. A memory tag (Filling, Draining) set and reset at the floats remembers.

questions.prompt: PLC+ scans every 10 ms. For how many milliseconds does a rising-edge contact pass power when its tag turns on?
questions.explanation: An edge contact passes power for exactly one scan.

questions.prompt: Which of these must the garage door's **Down** rung check? Choose every one.
options: StopPB (not pressed)
EyeClear (the doorway is clear)
NOT ClosedLimit (not already at the bottom)
NOT MotorUp (not going up: the interlock)
OpenLimit (at the top)
questions.explanation: The door must be able to come down from part-way open, so the top limit is not needed.
